# Dataquest

> > Dataquest is an interactive online platform for learning data science, Python, SQL, R, AI, and business analytics skills through hands-on, project-based courses and career paths.

Dataquest offers comprehensive career paths and skill tracks in data science, data analysis, data engineering, and business analytics, with courses in Python, R, SQL, Power BI, Tableau, Excel, and generative AI. The platform emphasizes practical, interactive learning with real-world projects and industry certifications.

## Key Topics

- Python programming
- SQL
- Machine learning
- Data analysis
- Data visualization
- Data science
- Career paths
- Power BI
- R programming
- Excel
- Generative AI
- Data engineering
- Tableau
- Business analytics
- Skill paths

## Career Paths

- [Data Scientist in Python Certificate Program](https://www.dataquest.io/path/data-scientist): Data Scientist certificate path: Python, scikit-learn, ML, data visualization training
- [Data Analyst in Python Certificate Program](https://www.dataquest.io/path/data-analyst): Data Analyst certificate: Python, SQL, Pandas, NumPy, statistical analysis training
- [Data Engineer](https://www.dataquest.io/path/data-engineering): Data Engineer path: Python, PostgreSQL, Snowflake, MongoDB, cloud deployment training
- [Data Analyst in R](https://www.dataquest.io/path/data-analyst-r): Data Analyst in R: RStudio, tidyverse, data visualization, SQL query training
- [Business Analyst Career Path](https://www.dataquest.io/path/business-analyst-with-power-bi): Business Analyst path: Power BI, Excel, SQL, PL-300 Microsoft certification prep
- [Business Analyst with Tableau](https://www.dataquest.io/path/business-analyst-with-tableau): Business Analyst with Tableau: data visualization, Excel, SQL, certification training
- [Junior Data Analyst](https://www.dataquest.io/path/junior-data-analyst): Junior Data Analyst path: Excel, SQL, Python fundamentals, entry-level career prep
- [Become a Data Scientist, Data Analyst, or Data Engineer](https://www.dataquest.io/catalog/career-paths): Career path overview: Data Scientist, Analyst, Engineer paths with Python, R, Power BI

## Core Learning Paths & Skills

- [Machine Learning Using Python](https://www.dataquest.io/path/machine-learning-in-python): Machine Learning path: Python, supervised/unsupervised learning, predictive modeling
- [Generative AI Fundamentals in Python](https://www.dataquest.io/path/generative-ai-fundamentals-skill-track): Generative AI fundamentals: Python, LLMs, APIs, prompt engineering, AI web apps
- [Zero to GPT](https://www.dataquest.io/path/zero-to-gpt-skill): Zero to GPT path: Python, PyTorch, Transformers, deep learning, neural networks
- [Learn SQL Skills for Data Analysis](https://www.dataquest.io/path/sql-skills): SQL skills path: database fundamentals, data analysis, interactive practice problems
- [Analyzing Data with Microsoft Power BI Skill Path](https://www.dataquest.io/path/analyzing-data-with-microsoft-power-bi-skill-path): Power BI skill path: Microsoft partnership, PL-300 certification, data modeling, BI
- [Data Literacy and Introduction to Data Analysis using Excel](https://www.dataquest.io/path/introduction-to-data-analysis-with-excel): Excel data analysis: PivotTables, visualization, linear regression, data literacy

## Courses & Skill Development

- [Data Science Courses](https://www.dataquest.io/catalog): Main course catalog featuring data science, Python, SQL, Excel, Power BI training
- [Data Skill Paths in Python, R, SQL, Power BI, and More](https://www.dataquest.io/catalog/skill-paths): Skill paths catalog: Python, R, SQL, Power BI, machine learning, deep learning courses
- [Python Fundamentals for Web Development](https://www.dataquest.io/path/python-fundamentals-for-web-development-skill-track): Python web development: syntax, APIs, OOP, decorators, local environment setup
